title: Implement a Fibonacci generator in Python
description: Implement fibonacci() generator using yield and a take(n, gen) helper that returns the first n values.

files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "fibonacci_gen"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = []

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["."]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]

task_spec.prompt:
Implement fibonacci() and take() in src/fibonacci.py:
- fibonacci(): generator using yield; start with a=0, b=1; yield a; then a,b = b, a+b; loop forever
- take(n, gen): return [next(gen) for _ in range(n)]
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
